profile.headline: Software Engineer at Fannie Mae
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with 3+ years of experience developing enterprise applications and implementing cloud solutions in the financial technology sector. Proven expertise in Node.js, Java, and Angular development with strong AWS implementation skills resulting in significant cost optimizations. Adept at bridging communication between technical teams and business stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: At Fannie Mae, I led the development and maintenance of enterprise applications using Node.js, Java, and Angular, while implementing AWS serverless frameworks that optimized operational efficiency and reduced costs by $10,000. I successfully managed the retirement and migration of a critical FHFA reporting legacy application by coordinating team communication and analyzing complex reporting logic, ensuring a seamless transition with zero data loss and maintaining regulatory compliance throughout the process.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: During my internship at Fannie Mae, I developed comprehensive automated test suites using Selenium that significantly improved test coverage for critical Salesforce applications while helping to transition major Selenium upgrades. I built optimized testing frameworks that leveraged Salesforce APIs for seamless data integration and processed large datasets for a machine learning-driven fraud detection model, contributing to a 15% improvement in detection accuracy and reducing false positives by 20%.

positions.title: Associate
positions.description: I drove operational efficiency and customer satisfaction through strategic initiatives. I led the multi-store inventory system upgrade, ensuring accurate stock management. I implemented a product tracking system, reducing inventory discrepancies. I also delivered exceptional customer service, driving sales and loyalty through expert product guidance and issue resolution.

organizations.name: Penn State Coffee Club
organizations.description: As President of Penn State's Coffee Club, I directed the strategic expansion of club operations and implemented new roasting and brewing programs that doubled membership and attendance. I managed capital improvements including the acquisition and integration of a $5,000 roasting system, established partnerships with local coffee businesses, and organized community events that increased club visibility on campus while providing members with hands-on experience in business management and operations.

organizations.name: Penn State Coffee Club
organizations.description: I managed the club's budget, implementing reconciliation processes with University funds to guarantee financial transparency and accountability. This meticulous approach secured the club's resources, enabling us to invest in growth and enhance member experiences. Additionally, I oversaw a comprehensive equipment inventory and developed a detailed budget for weekly meetings, proactively anticipating needs and streamlining resource allocation
